Maya (CSM): FYI Aperture showing a sudden spike in embeddings usage since Apr 20. QBR prep next Thu — need a 1-slide summary + mitigation asks.
Ravi (FinOps): 7d spike +95%. Quick forecast: if sustained, monthly runrate ~ $28k vs baseline $15k. Flagging renewal sensitivity.
budget-bot: Alert: account aperture-inc crossed soft threshold (daily spend 4.8k) at 2026-04-22T14:03Z.
Jules (Solutions Eng): Probable causes: increased query depth, index density change, or no batching. Low-effort wins: reduce embedding dim, enable batch calls, add caching for top queries.
Lena (Onboarding): I'll request sample query logs and set a 30m enablement for Tue. Can we offer a template checklist for what we need ahead of time?
Maya (CSM): Ask aperture to share top 500 calls + any recent code push notes. Ravi/Jules please provide 2-3 cost-saving plays with estimated % impact for the deck.
Ravi (FinOps): Draft plays: 1) Quota caps (soft=avg*1.3, hard=avg*2) 2) Short-term credit offset for campaign week 3) Move non-real-time analytics to nightly batch. Estimated savings if adopted: 35-55%.
Jules (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the tech play slide (512->256 dim trial, gpt-emb-small variant, prefix cache). ETA EOD.
Maya (CSM): Great. Action items: Lena -> get logs + run enablement. Ravi -> final forecast & credit rec (EOD). Jules -> plays slide. I'll assemble QBR slide and circulate tomorrow morning.
Lena (Onboarding): Invite sent for Tue 10am PT. Requested logs + top queries sample in the invite.
Maya (CSM): If needed we can enable temporary throttling via API: `POST /v1/accounts/aperture/quotas { "daily": 24000 }` (example). Will update when deck is ready. :thumbsup:
Ravi (FinOps): Noted — modelling renewal risk if >2x baseline for 30d. Will include runway calc in the deck.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team. Closing loop once deck link is live.
